# hg dev

**What this page tells you:** every `hg dev` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Watch loop: an edit commits, renders and syncs through the real git → argo cd path.

## Synopsis

```text
hg dev [<repo-path>]
```

## Description

Chart edits ship as `-dev.N` builds; everything still flows through the real git → Argo CD path, so what works in `dev` works deployed. Cold (nothing onboarded), `hg dev <repo-path>` runs the whole onramp - onboard → up → dev - narrating each command.
